name: Ho-Oh

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, choose 1 of your opponent's Pokémon. This attack does 80 damage to that Pokémon. This attack's damage isn't affected by Weakness or Resistance.

fl: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind when it flies.

name: Lugia

atk.x: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 50 damage plus 20 more damage for each heads.

fl: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

name: Pikachu

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Lightning Energy card and attach it to Pikachu. Shuffle your deck afterward.
Discard all Energy attached to Pikachu.

fl: It occasionally uses an electric shock to recharge a fellow Pikachu that is in a weakened state.

name: Wobbuffet

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, this attack does 20 damage plus 30 more damage.

ab.x: As long as Wobbuffet is your Active Pokémon, your opponent's Active Pokémon's Retreat Cost is ColorlessColorless more.

fl: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.

name: Hoothoot
fl: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

name: Noctowl

atk.x: The Defending Pokémon is now Asleep.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at your opponent's hand. This power can't be used if Noctowl is affected by a Special Condition.

fl: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.

atk.x: Does 60 damage plus 10 more damage for each damage counter on the Defending Pokémon.

ab.x: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may attach a Water Energy from your hand to 1 of your Water Pokémon. This power can't be used if Feraligatr is affected by a Special Condition.

As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move a Grass Energy attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon. This power can't be used if Meganium is affected by a Special Condition.

atk.x: Discard an Energy card attached to Typhlosion and discard an Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

ab.x: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may search your discard pile for a Fire Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Pokémon. If you do, put 1 damage counter on that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Typhlosion is affected by a Special Condition.

name: Latias

atk.x: Search your discard pile for a basic Energy card and attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
If Latios is on your Bench, remove 2 damage counters from each of your Benched Pokémon.

fl: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.

name: Latios

atk.x: Discard 2 Energy attached to Latios.

ab.x: If you have Latias in play, the Retreat Cost for Latios is 0.

fl: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.

name: Cleffa

atk.x: Shuffle your hand into your deck, then draw 6 cards. Cleffa is now Asleep.

ab.x: As long as Cleffa is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Cleffa by attacks.

fl: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: Smoochum

atk.x: Move an Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon to another of your opponent's Pokémon. Smoochum is now Asleep.

ab.x: As long as Smoochum is Asleep, prevent all damage done to Smoochum by attacks.

fl: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

name: Lapras

atk.x: Search your discard pile for a Supporter card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand.

fl: It ferries people across the sea on its back. It may sing an enchanting cry if it is in a good mood.

name: Shuckle

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all damage done to Shuckle by attacks during your opponent's next turn.

ab.x: Whenever you attach an Energy card from your hand to Shuckle, draw a card.

fl: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.

name: Plusle

atk.x: Draw 2 cards.
Flip a coin. If tails, Plusle does 10 damage to itself.

fl: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.

name: Minun

atk.x: Search your deck for up to 2 Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Shuffle your deck afterward.
If Plusle is on your Bench, this attack does 10 damage plus 20 more damage.

fl: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

name: Tropical Tidal Wave
ru: Flip a coin. If heads, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards your opponent has in play. If tails, discard all Trainer and Stadium cards you have in play.

name: Raikou

atk.x: During your next turn, Raikou can't use Zap Cannon.

fl: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: Entei

atk.x: Discard all Fire Energy attached to Entei.

fl: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

name: Suicune

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon can't attack during your opponent's next turn.

fl: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: Porygon

atk.x: During your opponent's next turn, any damage done to Porygon by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Search your deck for Porygon2, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.

fl: It is a manmade Pokémon. Since it doesn't breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment..

name: Porygon2

atk.x: Porygon2 does 10 damage to itself.

ab.x: The Retreat Cost for each Porygon, Porygon2, and Porygon-Z you have in play is Colorless less.

fl: This upgraded version of Porygon is designed for space exploration. It can't fly, though.

name: Hitmonchan

atk.x: Flip a coin. If heads, prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Hitmonchan during your opponent's next turn.
This attack's damage isn't affected by Resistance.

fl: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

name: Hitmonlee
fl: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
